body:
Ported REDGARDEN's cel-shading technique (GLSL 3-band N.L quantization + inverted-hull outline, apps/arena S180-09) into PAPERCRAFT's legacy fixed-function client: new cel_color3f/cel_color4f helpers band per-face diffuse (city grid, Paper Engine props+fragments+debris via cross-product normals, player marker); outline pre-pass (scale-from-origin + glCullFace(GL_FRONT)) applied to player marker + Paper Engine props specifically, matching REDGARDEN's own hero-box-only outline scoping. Controller punch: wrote a standalone SDL2 virtual-joystick probe (SDL_JoystickAttachVirtual, headless dummy driver) confirming a real X-button press produces SDL_CONTROLLERBUTTONDOWN(BUTTON_X) -- the exact condition the existing punch/interact handler checks. PASSED. Verified: bazel build //apps/client/... clean. Commit 02c9aa4. Known blocker, flagged not worked around: PAPERCRAFT/CHANGELOG.md has a restrictive ACL (mask r--, owner treeiii) that blocked this session's write -- CHANGELOG entry not applied, needs treeiii or a mask fix (setfacl -m mask::rwx) to unblock future agent writes to that file.

⚓ ☃
title: S231: cel-shading (REDGARDEN-style) + verified controller punch
